python3 - <<'PY'
import os, time, json, pathlib
st=pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser('~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state'))
for name in ['poller.heartbeat','poller.pid','heartbeat']:
    p=st/name
    if p.exists():
        age=time.time()-p.stat().st_mtime
        print(name, 'age_s=', round(age,1), 'size=', p.stat().st_size)
        if p.stat().st_size<200:
            print(' content=', p.read_text()[:200])
# find heartbeat files
for p in st.glob('*heart*'):
    print('found', p.name, 'age', round(time.time()-p.stat().st_mtime,1))
for p in st.glob('poller*'):
    print('found', p.name, 'age', round(time.time()-p.stat().st_mtime,1), 'sz', p.stat().st_size)
PY
